Which export files a one-group run needs from the groups downstream of it

Source: R/lnk_downstream.R
lnk_downstream_files.Rd

A group's access is classified by walking downstream through the barriers and barrier overrides that every other group persisted. On a machine that holds only some groups, those rows come from the habitat export: this lists, for a target group, every group whose rows its walk can read (the export's dependency map, which errs wide) and the per-group parts holding them.

Usage

lnk_downstream_files(
  manifest,
  wsg,
  config,
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("link", "cache")
)

Arguments

manifest

Path or URL (s3://, https://) of an export's manifest.json.

wsg

The target watershed group.

config

The config whose parts to list, as the export names it.

cache_dir

Where the downloaded dependency map is kept.

Value

A data frame, one row per dependency and table (one row for a dependency with nothing to fetch): target, config, wsg, class, reason, table, key, href, rows, bytes, md5, run_id, config_hash, link_version, link_sha, fwa_url.

Details

Each dependency is one of:

  • exported: its barriers and barrier_overrides parts are listed, with the build they came from;

  • skipped: the export asked for it and had no finished build of the config; its rows are not available, and lnk_downstream_load() refuses unless told to go on without them;

  • not_held: the export took every group its schemas held and this one was not among them, so the provincial walk read no rows of it either;

  • not_exported: the export named its groups and left this one out.

The target's own rows are not listed: its run writes them. fwa_url names the dependency's FWA stream object, which a machine needs loaded for the downstream check (lnk_wsg_downstream_check()) and for the target's own gradient search, which runs along whole lines.

See also

Other export: lnk_catalog(), lnk_db_load(), lnk_downstream_load(), lnk_scenario_export()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
f <- lnk_downstream_files("s3://fresh-bc/habitat/fwa/v1/manifest.json",
                          wsg = "PARS", config = "default")
f[, c("wsg", "class", "table", "rows")]
} # }
